---
name: slack-api
description: Interact with the Slack Web API — post messages and thread replies, send direct messages, read channel history, list channels and users, and upload files to Slack. Use when the user asks to post or send a Slack message or DM, retrieve Slack messages or channel history, look up Slack channels or users, or upload a file to a Slack workspace.
---

# Slack API

Work with a Slack workspace through the Slack Web API (https://api.slack.com). All calls authenticate with a bearer token from the `SLACK_TOKEN` environment variable (or `--token`). Requires Node.js 18+ (uses built-in `fetch`; no dependencies).

## Quick start

Set the token once:

```bash
export SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-...   # bot or user token; or pass --token <token> per call
```

Common operations:

```bash
node scripts/slack_api.cjs post-message --channel general --text "Deploy finished"
node scripts/slack_api.cjs reply --channel general --thread-ts 1720000000.123456 --text "agreed"
node scripts/slack_api.cjs dm --user @alice --text "Can you review the PR?"
node scripts/slack_api.cjs history --channel C1234567890 --limit 20
node scripts/slack_api.cjs list-channels
node scripts/slack_api.cjs list-users
node scripts/slack_api.cjs upload-file --channel C1234567890 --file ./report.pdf --initial-comment "Q3 report"
node scripts/slack_api.cjs delete-message --channel general --ts 1720000000.123456
```

Run `node scripts/slack_api.cjs --help` for the full option reference. Add `--json` for raw API output.

## Workflow

1. **Common operations**: use `scripts/slack_api.cjs`. It handles auth, error surfacing (including `missing_scope` and rate limits), channel-name resolution, user lookup, and cursor pagination.
2. **Anything not covered** (search, reactions, Block Kit payloads, workflows, etc.): call the Web API directly with `fetch` or `curl` against `https://slack.com/api/<method>` with header `Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN`.
3. **Before direct calls**, read `references/api.md` for endpoint details, required OAuth scopes, pagination, rate limits, and gotchas (including the current file-upload flow, since `files.upload` is deprecated).

## Tokens & scopes

- Bot tokens (`xoxb-`) are typical; user tokens (`xoxp-`) act as the user.
- Missing permissions fail with `missing_scope`; the script prints the needed scope (e.g. `chat:write`).
- Posting to a public channel the bot is not a member of requires the `chat:write.public` scope.

## Guidance for direct API calls

- Responses always contain `ok`; on failure, `error` (and sometimes `needed`). Always check `ok` before reading data.
- Timestamps (`ts`, `thread_ts`) are float epoch seconds as strings — pass them through unchanged and compare numerically.
- `conversations.history` and `conversations.list` are cursor-paginated via `response_metadata.next_cursor`; per-page limits are 200.
- On `ratelimited`, honor the `Retry-After` header and back off.

# Slack Web API Reference

Reference for direct Slack Web API usage. Read this when `scripts/slack_api.cjs` (see SKILL.md) does not cover the operation, or to understand scopes, errors, and edge cases.

## Contents

- [Authentication & tokens](#authentication--tokens)
- [Request format](#request-format)
- [Response format](#response-format)
- [OAuth scopes by operation](#oauth-scopes-by-operation)
- [Endpoint quick reference](#endpoint-quick-reference)
- [Pagination](#pagination)
- [Rate limits](#rate-limits)
- [Common errors](#common-errors)
- [Message formatting](#message-formatting)
- [Uploading files (current flow)](#uploading-files-current-flow)
- [Gotchas](#gotchas)

## Authentication & tokens

- Base URL: `https://slack.com/api/`
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Bot tokens start with `xoxb-`; user tokens with `xoxp-`. Bot tokens act as the bot app; user tokens act as the user.
- Never hardcode tokens; read from an environment variable (`SLACK_TOKEN`).

## Request format

- POST `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (or JSON with `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`). GET with query params also works for most methods.
- Example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "channel=general" \
  --data-urlencode "text=Hello from curl"
```

## Response format

- Always JSON: `{ "ok": true, ... }` or `{ "ok": false, "error": "...", "needed": "scope" }`.
- Always check `ok` before reading data.
- Timestamps (`ts`, `thread_ts`) are float epoch seconds as strings, e.g. `"1720000000.123456"`.

## OAuth scopes by operation

| Operation | Method(s) | Scopes (bot token) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Post message / reply | `chat.postMessage` | `chat:write` (+ `chat:write.public` to post where the bot is not a member) |
| Send DM | `conversations.open` → `chat.postMessage` | `im:write`, `chat:write` |
| Delete message | `chat.delete` | `chat:write` |
| Read channel history | `conversations.history` | `channels:history`, `groups:history`, `im:history`, `mpim:history` |
| List conversations | `conversations.list` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` |
| List users | `users.list` | `users:read` |
| Upload file | `files.getUploadURLExternal` + `files.completeUploadExternal` | `files:write` |

## Endpoint quick reference

| Method | Key params | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat.postMessage` | `channel` (name or ID), `text`, `thread_ts`, `reply_broadcast`, `blocks`, `link_names` | `text` required unless `blocks` given; 40,000 char limit |
| `chat.delete` | `channel`, `ts` | Only messages posted by the same token |
| `conversations.history` | `channel` (ID), `limit` (max 200), `latest`, `oldest`, `inclusive` | `has_more` in response |
| `conversations.list` | `types` (default `public_channel`), `limit` (max 200), `cursor`, `exclude_archived` | `types`: comma list of `public_channel,private_channel,im,mpim` |
| `users.list` | `limit` (max 200), `cursor`, `team_id` | Members have `id`, `name`, `real_name`, `profile.display_name`, `is_bot`, `deleted` |
| `conversations.open` | `users` (comma-separated IDs) | Returns `channel.id` (starts with `D`) |
| `files.getUploadURLExternal` | `filename`, `length` (bytes), `alt_text`, `snippet_type` | Returns `upload_url`, `file_id` |
| `files.completeUploadExternal` | `file_id`, `channel_ids`, `title`, `initial_comment` | Returns `files[0].permalink` |

## Pagination

- `conversations.list` and `users.list` (and history) return `response_metadata.next_cursor`.
- Loop: pass `cursor` from the previous page until it is empty; keep `limit` per page (200 max).

```js
let cursor = '';
do {
  const res = await fetch(`https://slack.com/api/conversations.list?limit=200&cursor=${cursor}`, opts);
  const data = await res.json();
  // use data.channels
  cursor = data.response_metadata?.next_cursor || '';
} while (cursor);
```

## Rate limits

- Tier-based per app; burst and daily caps. On `error: "ratelimited"`, the response includes a `Retry-After` header (seconds) — wait that long before retrying.
- Use exponential backoff for transient failures.

## Common errors

| `error` | Meaning / fix |
| --- | --- |
| `not_authed`, `invalid_auth` | Missing or invalid token |
| `account_inactive` | Token was revoked |
| `missing_scope` | Token lacks a scope; response includes `needed` |
| `invalid_channel`, `channel_not_found` | Wrong ID, or bot cannot see the channel |
| `not_in_channel` | Bot not a member; needs `chat:write.public` for public channels or an invite |
| `is_archived` | Cannot post to an archived channel |
| `message_too_long` | Text exceeds 40,000 chars |
| `rate_limited` | Honor `Retry-After` |
| `user_not_found` | Wrong user ID |
| `file_too_large` | Free plans cap files at 1 MB |
| `invalid_blocks` | Block Kit payload is malformed |

## Message formatting

- Markdown: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `` `code` ``, ` ```pre``` `
- Links with labels: `<https://example.com|click here>`
- Emoji: `:white_check_mark:`
- Mention a user by ID: `<@U1234567890>`; channel by ID: `<#C1234567890>`
- Set `link_names=true` to let Slack parse `@name` / `#channel`
- Rich messages use Block Kit: pass `blocks` (array); `text` becomes the fallback for notifications and clients that don't render blocks

## Uploading files (current flow)

`files.upload` is deprecated (removal announced); use the three-step flow:

1. `POST files.getUploadURLExternal` with `filename`, `length` (bytes), `alt_text` → returns `upload_url` + `file_id`
2. `POST` the file content to `upload_url` as multipart form field `file` (signed URL; keep the Bearer header)
3. `POST files.completeUploadExternal` with `file_id`, `channel_ids`, `title`, `initial_comment` → returns `files[0]` with `permalink`

## Gotchas

- `ts` values are strings — compare numerically (e.g. `parseFloat`) for history ranges.
- `chat.postMessage` accepts channel names; `conversations.history` requires IDs. Resolve names via `conversations.list`.
- Prefer the Conversations API (`conversations.*`) over legacy `channels.*`, `im.*`, `groups.*` methods.
- DMs: call `conversations.open` first, then post to the returned IM `channel.id` (starts with `D`). Private channels start with `G`.
- The bot must be a member of private channels/MPIMs to read or post.
- `chat.update` / `chat.delete` only work on messages posted by the same token.
